flow.strictHelp: A strict current-user match above the threshold blocks independently of model review.
flow.learningModelHelp: Moderations only scores content. Draft generation uses a chat model from the same provider and key pool.
flow.reviewHelp: Local policy still runs when review is off. Configure the endpoint, model and keys before enabling review.
flow.failHelp: When off, retain the local decision. A reviewer outage never clears a local block.
flow.keyPoolHelp: {count} keys saved. Separate keys with commas or semicolons for round-robin use. Blank preserves keys; Clear removes them.
flow.lockHelp: Scoped to the client key and provider. Without a session identity, lock only the same prompt fingerprint.
flow.learningHelp: Only bounded redacted text is stored. Draft generation and publication require an admin action.
flow.evaluateHelp: Local evaluation uses saved rules. It does not call upstream or the reviewer, or store the input. Unsaved drafts are excluded.
flow.profileHelp: Retained root requests from the last 30 days. History and tool matches do not count as user violations. No automatic key-wide bans.
flow.releaseConfirm: Release the session and prompt locks from this upstream rejection? Future requests will be reviewed again.
flow.locksHelp: Active locks are paginated by expiry. Releasing an incident clears its session and prompt locks for the corresponding client key and provider.
flow.learningQueueHelp: Filter evidence by its source provider. Edit or generate a draft, then publish it manually. Published rules apply to both Codex and Claude.
flow.onePatternPerLine: One expression per line, up to 8.
flow.publishConfirm: Publish the saved rule? It will affect subsequent Codex and Claude requests.
flow.lockUnknown: Lock status unconfirmed; check Risk profiles

help.local: Local filtering and model review are independent. Observe mode records the would-be action and allows requests. Enforcement applies the local warning or blocking policy. Only current-user text contributes to the decision score; instructions, history and tools contribute audit evidence.
help.review: Review can cover local candidates or all requests. A clean result can clear an ordinary local match, but not a strict terminal rule. Review failures remain distinguishable from risk; fail-open does not clear an existing local block.
help.upstream: Explicit cyber_policy / content_policy_violation is terminal and must not trigger account rotation. Session locks are isolated by client key and protocol, falling back to prompt fingerprints. Timeouts, 429, quotas and authentication retain provider scheduling.
help.learning: The flow is upstream rejection, redacted evidence, manual or model draft, human review, publication, then runtime enforcement. Incomplete evidence cannot generate drafts automatically. Models cannot publish rules; mutations use revision checks.
help.coverage: Text evaluation covers Codex Responses HTTP and WebSocket, Claude Messages and count_tokens. Images, audio and encrypted content are outside text coverage. Transparent tunnels and NewAPI integration are excluded.
help.retention: Assessments and learning evidence follow request retention. Published rules remain active when evidence expires. Keys, drafts and raw prompts are not persisted in browser storage.

clientProfile.followHelp: Requests must supply a complete, consistent Claude Code identity. Existing threads retain their original identity.
